entries.subject: But
entries.object: I see the mendicants leading the spiritual life entirely full and pure as long as they live

spans.text: But here I see the mendicants leading the spiritual life entirely full and pure as long as they live, to their last breath.
But here I see the mendicants living in harmony, appreciating each other, without dispute, blending like milk and water, and regarding each other with kindly eyes.
But here I see mendicants always smiling and joyful, obviously happy, with cheerful faces, living relaxed, unruffled, surviving on charity, their hearts free as a wild deer.
